observation.visible_scene: A child's marble-run toy photographed from above on a beige carpet. Center-right is a large red conical funnel mounted on a striped post, with a fixed blue hub at its bottom and a red/yellow tube and a green wheel element attached on the right. Left is an orange board carrying a white serpentine foam track ending at a blue clip. Background holds a yellow toy dump truck, a green price box ($4.99), a white wall and dark wood cabinets. Several small marbles (lavender-pink, pale green, dark blue) sit inside the red funnel.
visible_changes: The pink, pale-green and dark-blue marbles inside the red funnel continuously change their angular positions around the central hub, tracing a swirling/circular pattern across the frames (e.g. the green marble moves from the right side to the top to the left side and back around), so the cluster of marbles orbits the bowl rather than staying put.

Marbles also appear and shift along the funnel's outer rim and in the right-side tube / green wheel: a pale-green marble rides the right tube (~frames 12-13), and pink and blue marbles successively show up in the green-wheel area at the upper right (later frames).
A dark-blue marble appears at the left, near the blue clip and the top edge of the green box, and its position shifts along that left region over the middle frames.
The white serpentine track on the orange board remains empty throughout; no marble enters it.
The background (truck, boxes, wall, cabinets) and the camera viewpoint stay fixed; all observed motion is object motion, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the marbles were initially loaded into the funnel and what happens to them after they leave the right-side tube is not shown.
Whether the funnel bowl itself is motor-driven/rotating or the marbles are rolling on their own cannot be determined from the visible markers.
The source of the left-side blue marble and its eventual path are not visible.
uncertain_details: The exact trajectory of the left blue marble (one continuous move vs. two separate appearances) is ambiguous.
Distinguishing bowl rotation from independent marble rolling is not resolvable from these frames; only the relative circular rearrangement of the marbles is directly supported.
